ios.desc:
Take back control of your time with Giraffocus – the Screen Time Control App.

Please note: All app functionality requires an in-app purchase (subscription or lifetime). The app can be downloaded for free, but features are available only after purchase.

Block distracting apps and websites, save hours every day, and bring focus back into your life.

With Giraffocus you don’t just block apps — you unlock mindful habits. Before opening a distracting app, you’ll pause for a few seconds, giving your brain the chance to reset and choose consciously.

Features available after purchase:
• Block apps & websites – stay in control of your screen time  
• Mindful pause – reduce impulsive scrolling  
• Custom groups & limits – tailor rules for social, shopping, and games  
• Save hours every day – focus on what truly matters  
• Simple & cute design – guided by your little giraffe companion  

Whether you want to stay focused at work, study without distractions, or spend less time on your phone, Giraffocus makes it simple.

Terms (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/  
Privacy Policy: https://kwcodes.com/privacy/
